name        tri
label       Three-bead chain for the t_library unit tests: SOL-MID-SOL
# MID carries q = +0.5 so charge parsing has something to read, which leaves
# tri deliberately not charge-balanced. Info --check-library reports that, and
# it is correct to: this is a parsing fixture, not a chemistry library.
role        bilayer
M_w         5.00

beads
#   bead_ID                     x        y        z
 1  SOL                    0.0000   0.0000   0.0000
 2  MID                    0.2500   0.0000   0.0000
 3  SOL                    0.7500   0.0000   0.0000

bonds
#   bond_ID      i   j
 1  b01          1   2
 2  b02          2   3

angles
#   angle_ID     i   j   k
 1  a01          1   2   3
